events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the indelible mark Tupac Shakur left on music and culture, 30 years after that fateful night in Vegas.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Still electrifying generations. We remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970.

events.title: Abbey Road Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic album cover, those legendary tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still a true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still sounding biblical.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine UK Release
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: A timeless message from a legend. John Lennon's 'Imagine' saw its UK release on this day in '75. Still resonating today.

events.title: Original iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember lugging around your CD Walkman? Then came the original iPod, unveiled on this day in 2001, and everything changed.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's enduring legacy since Dr. No premiered on this day.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A double album, a blank canvas, and some of their most diverse tracks. The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Still rocking us. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in '91, but whose voice lives forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived on this day in '65, changing everything.
